feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 27 November 2026 6:00am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong to gale force winds at first.


##Wind)##

South or Southeast 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8 at first, but becoming West or Northwest 3 or 4 this morning. Becoming Variable 2 to 4 during afternoon and evening, then settling Southeast 4 or 5 early tonight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, falling slight during today.


##Weather)##

Rain at first clearing, becoming fair.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor, soon improving good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 10°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Southeast 4 or 5, soon increasing 5 or 6 occasionally 7, then veering West or Southwest 5 or 6 later in day.


##State of sea)##

Slight, building moderate, moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 10°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C

##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Southwest 5 or 6.


##State of sea)##

Moderate.


##Weather)##

Showers later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

##Sea Temperature##

12°C

##Warnings)##

Strong to gale force winds developing.


##Wind)##

South or Southwest 5 or 6, increasing 7 or gale 8.

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough, then generally rough later.


##Weather)##

Strong to gale force winds at first.

Rough, falling slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Rain clearing.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor, becoming good.

12°C
